title: accepted_under_contract (kind_of_entry: accepted_under_contract)
description: The terminal verdict `verdict conclude` appends on the clean path: the governor's Ed25519-signed statement that an issue's evidence concluded under the contract, having checked for escapes. Always author==commissaire. `accepted_under_contract` is the stored kind; `conclude` is the CLI action. A conclude on an issue with zero ledger records is refused (`no-evidence`) and writes nothing. Shape normative here; semantics in ../records.md.

evidence_seq_range.description: [min seq, max seq] over the issue's entries this verdict concludes

escapes_checked.description: true — conclude refuses on any unreconciled escape before signing
